description: This Dart file defines a Flutter widget called BoardGrid, which renders a 3x3 Tic Tac Toe game board with themed styling, animations, and accessibility features. It includes internal subclasses for individual tiles and manages interactions for placing moves.

classes.name: BoardGrid
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that renders the Tic Tac Toe 3x3 grid with themed styles and animations.

classes.name: _BoardTile
classes.description: A StatelessWidget representing each individual cell/tile on the game board, with accessibility and interaction handling.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the BoardGrid and _BoardTile widgets, handling layout, styling, and interaction logic.

methods.name: _buildIcon
methods.description: Returns the appropriate icon widget (X or O) based on the tile's value.
